metadata.description: Infinite Leverage — per-project AI team scaffold

plugins.name: infiniteleverage
plugins.description: Infinite Leverage product plugin: /il-project scaffolds a client project with its own 6-agent team (project-scoped, never global); /il-doctor checks the setup; /il-memory-cleanup tidies a multi-account memory mess with the human in the loop. Telemetry lives in the separate private edge8-telemetry plugin.
